title: Finite algebraic comparisons for constant reduction towers
statement: Let W, A, J and H satisfy the hypotheses of [lem-sfb-constant-reductions-finite-projective-model]: W is affine with exact final sections of set sheaves, A is commutative Noetherian, H is locally derived J-complete, every canonical reduction H_n is individually constant, and its algebraic residue marking is perfect. For each integer q there is a Mittag–Leffler inverse system U of coefficient-sized sets and a finite-triple range comparison [lem-sfb-finite-triple-range-ml-transfer] from the actual degree-q reduction-cohomology-and-final-sections tower to U.

source.place: Tag 09C5, local algebraicity, perfect inverse-limit reconstruction, and finite-triple comparison paragraph

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-constant-reductions-finite-projective-model]. It supplies one bounded finite-projective complex P over B = AdicCompletion J A and the finite-triple comparisons with the actual constant-section quotient-cohomology towers.

The ring B is Noetherian by [lem-weil-pbc-adic-completion-noetherian]. Each outgoing term of P is finite. Apply [lem-sfb-adic-short-complex-cohomology-ml] to the degree-q short complex with ideal JB. Its actual quotient-cohomology tower is Mittag–Leffler; exact constant-module sections preserve this condition. Pair this stabilization with the model comparison, obtaining the required U.

proof_origin.place: Tag 09C5: geometric model comparison followed by direct Artin–Rees and exact sections.

theorem wcontractible_constant_reductions_finite_comparison
    (W : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine W]
    (_hW : ∀ (F G : Sheaf (ProEt.topology W) (Type (u + 1))) (f : F ⟶ G),
      Epi f → Function.Surjective (f.hom.app (op (⊤_ W.ProEt))))
    (A : Type (max v (u + 1))) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] (J : Ideal A)
    (H : ConstantCompletion.D
      (ConstantCompletion.constant (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} W) A))
    (_hcomplete : ConstantCompletion.IsComplete
      (ConstantCompletion.quotient (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} W) A J 0) H)
    (_hconstant : ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ E : MLAlgebraDerived (A ⧸ J ^ (n + 1)),
      (n = 0 → MLAlgebraPerfect E) ∧
      Nonempty
        ((ConstantCompletion.extend
            (ConstantCompletion.quotient (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} W) A J n)).obj H ≅
          mlConstantDerivedObject W (A ⧸ J ^ (n + 1)) E)) (q : ℤ) :
    ∃ U : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ Type (max v (u + 1)),
      U.IsMittagLeffler ∧
      CategoryTheory.Functor.FiniteTripleRangeComparison
        (mlHypercohomologyTower W A J H q) U
